advancements.ancient_remnants_add.ancien: Collect every research entry and complete the Monolith Codex.
Discover a ruined altar of the Ancient Heart.
advancements.ancient_remnants_add.glory_: Repair the altar, offer a complete Monolith Codex, and awaken the Ancient Heart.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.incom: The Ancient Heart requires a complete Monolith Codex.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.activ: The Ancient Heart awakens above the spire.
message.ancient_remnants_add.altar.sacri: The Ancient Heart shatters. The codex falls.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page1: Getting & repair: the Ancient Heart has a 25% chance in ancient city/ice box chests. The broken altar has four air cells at its center; place the 2x2 Ancient Heart there to repair the site. The site record persists.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page2: Activation: hold a complete Monolith Codex, stand anywhere in the 32x25x32 altar area, and sneak + hold right-click for 2 seconds. The codex is consumed and stored. Sneak prevents the codex GUI.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page3: After activation: the altar repairs itself to the template, clears unrelated blocks and non-living entities (arrows, drops, ender pearls), the dormant core appears above the central spire, and the whole 32x25x32 structure is indestructible.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page4: Blessing boost: each active altar gives +100% (configurable, additive) to blessings listed in altar_boost.json, capped per blessing. Below 3 altars only inside the altar area; 3-8 dimension-wide; 9+ source dimension + data-file spread dimensions.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page5: Create: disabled at 1-2 altars; 3-8 dimension-wide chance x1.5; 9+ source dimension and data-file spread dimensions.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page6: Sacrifice & reactivation: after activation, a player kill of a mob in altar_sacrifices (default villager) inside the altar destroys the heart, extinguishes the altar, and drops the codex at the center. The site remains and can be repaired/reactivated.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page7: Other: inactive hearts drop with silk touch; discovering the altar grants Phantom of the Past, activating grants Glory Reborn. Old Altars data is not migrated.
jei.ancient_remnants_add.altar.page8: Altar harvest: crops in altar_harvestable also follow the same tiers: below 3 altars only inside the altar area; 3-8 dimension-wide; 9+ source dimension + data-file spread dimensions. The chance is still bountifulHarvestChance and does not stack per altar.
